Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol rah.text: Ramesh says hello to Sunita madam and says he is Ramesh, a painter.
Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol rah.quote: Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol raha hoon, painter. Aapne message kiya tha.

Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol rah.text: Ramesh says Sunita had messaged him before.
Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol rah.quote: Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol raha hoon, painter. Aapne message kiya tha.

Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.text: Sunita says the job is to paint the flat.
Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.quote: Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karwana hai. Aap kal dekh ke gaye the na?

Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.text: Sunita refers back to Ramesh having come to look at the place yesterday.
Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.quote: Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karwana hai. Aap kal dekh ke gaye the na?

Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kam.text: Ramesh says he has seen the place and specifies that it is a 2BHK with two rooms, a hall, a kitchen, and bathroom doors to be done too.
Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kam.quote: Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kamre, hall, kitchen. Bathroom ke darwaze bhi karne hain na?

Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing.text: Sunita adds the balcony railing, says the walls need two coats, and the ceiling needs one coat.
Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing.quote: Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing bhi. Walls pe do coat chahiye, ceiling pe ek chalega.

Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.text: Ramesh accepts the already discussed scope: two coats on the walls, one coat on the ceiling, enamel on the doors and railing, and putty where needed.
Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.value: walls two coats, ceiling one coat, doors and railing enamel, putty where needed
Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.quote: Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek coat, darwaze aur railing pe enamel. Putty jahan zaroorat ho wahan kar dunga.

Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.text: Sunita says she will bring the paint herself and Ramesh only has to quote labour.
Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.value: paint supplied by hirer; labour only
Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.quote: Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki dukaan hai. Aap sirf labour ka batao.

Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.text: Ramesh says the labour-only job will cost 15,000 rupees.
Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.quote: Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka madam... 15 hazaar lagega.

Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.text: Ramesh says the hirer will provide the material.
Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.quote: Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka madam... 15 hazaar lagega.

15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi t.text: Sunita says 15,000 rupees is too much for the job.
15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi t.quote: 15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi to hai.

Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.text: Ramesh says three people will be needed and the job will take six days.
Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.quote: Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka kaam hai.

Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.text: Ramesh offers to do the labour-only job for 14,000 rupees.

12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon..text: Sunita says to do the job for 12,000 rupees.
12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon..quote: 12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon.

12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, l.text: The worker says the price would be 13,000 rupees, last.
12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, l.quote: 12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, last. Isse neeche nahi.

Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.text: Sunita accepts 13,000 rupees for the job.
Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.quote: Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, material mera.

Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.text: Sunita confirms that the hirer supplies the material and only labour is included.
Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.value: labor only; material provided by hirer
Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.quote: Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, material mera.

Advance kitna loge?.text: Sunita asks how much advance Ramesh will take.

3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena.text: Worker Ramesh asks for 3,000 rupees as advance for the boys' payments.
3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena.quote: 3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena padta hai.

Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.text: Sunita accepts the 3,000 rupees advance proposed by Ramesh.
Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.quote: Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi, cash mein.

Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.text: Sunita says she will give the 3,000 rupees advance tomorrow morning in cash.
Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.quote: Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi, cash mein.

Ji. Aur baaki?.text: The worker asks what about the remaining payment.

Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din f.text: The hirer says the rest will be paid after the work is fully done, on the day it is finished, after she checks the work first.
Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din f.value: after completion, on finish day, after inspection
Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din f.quote: Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din finish karoge usi din. Pehle main kaam dekhungi, phir payment.

Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.text: The worker says the remaining payment will be given on completion after the work is inspected, and he is restating the schedule as total 14,000 rupees with 3,000 advance and the rest at finish.
Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.quote: Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. To total 14 hazaar mein se 3 advance, baaki finish hone pe.

Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.text: The worker says the total is 14,000 rupees.
Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.quote: Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. To total 14 hazaar mein se 3 advance, baaki finish hone pe.

Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.text: The worker says the advance is 3,000 rupees.
Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.quote: Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. To total 14 hazaar mein se 3 advance, baaki finish hone pe.

Haan haan theek hai. Achha, shuru kab se.text: Sunita asks when Ramesh will start the work.
Haan haan theek hai. Achha, shuru kab se.quote: Haan haan theek hai. Achha, shuru kab se karoge?

Parson se madam, Wednesday. Kal kamron s.text: The worker says the work will start the day after tomorrow, Wednesday.
The worker asks the hirer to remove the room contents tomorrow.
Parson se madam, Wednesday. Kal kamron s.quote: Kal kamron se saamaan hata lijiyega.

Aur khatam kab hoga?.text: Sunita asks when the work will finish.

Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.text: The worker says the job will start Wednesday and finish by next Monday.
Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.value: start Wednesday, finish by next Monday
Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.quote: Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho jayega.

Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office.text: Sunita asks whether the work will be completed by Monday.

Pakka madam, Monday shaam tak..text: The worker says the finish is confirmed for Monday evening.

Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale.text: The hirer asks what happens if the worker leaves the job midway.
Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale.quote: Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale gaye to? Aajkal bahut hota hai ye.

Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam.text: The worker says if he leaves the work unfinished, the hirer should not pay the remaining money and he will return the advance.
Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam.quote: Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam adhoora chhoda to baaki paise mat dena, aur advance bhi wapas kar dunga.

Theek hai. Aur late hua to?.text: Sunita accepts the worker's rule that if he leaves the work unfinished, the remaining money should not be paid and the advance should be returned.
Theek hai. Aur late hua to?.value: if unfinished, no remaining payment and advance returned

Late hua to roz ka 300 rupaye kaat lena.text: Ramesh says that if the job is late, 300 rupees should be deducted per day.
Late hua to roz ka 300 rupaye kaat lena.quote: Late hua to roz ka 300 rupaye kaat lena madam.

Chalo theek hai. To Wednesday subah aa j.text: Sunita accepts the Wednesday start and Monday evening finish that Ramesh had proposed.
Chalo theek hai. To Wednesday subah aa j.quote: Chalo theek hai. To Wednesday subah aa jao, 10 baje.

Ji madam, Wednesday 10 baje. Paint tab t.quote: Ji madam, Wednesday 10 baje. Paint tab tak mangwa lijiyega.

Ji madam, Wednesday 10 baje. Paint tab t.text: The worker asks the hirer to arrange the paint by then.
Ji madam, Wednesday 10 baje. Paint tab t.quote: Ji madam, Wednesday 10 baje. Paint tab tak mangwa lijiyega.

Haan kal hi aa jayega. Theek hai phir, r.text: Sunita says it will come tomorrow and says goodbye for now.
Haan kal hi aa jayega. Theek hai phir, r.quote: Haan kal hi aa jayega. Theek hai phir, rakhti hoon.
